legal.privacyMetaDesc: OmniCommerce privacy policy: the information we collect, how we use it, and your rights.
legal.privacyIntro: OmniCommerce (“we”) provides a platform that helps merchants create and run online stores. This policy describes the information we collect when you use the service and how we handle it.
legal.privacyItem1Body: name, email, password (hashed), and the store details you create.
legal.privacyItem2Body: products, orders, customer information and the content you upload to your store.
legal.privacyItem3Body: IP address, browser type and access logs used for security and operations.
legal.privacyP2: We use information to provide and improve the service, process orders, send account-related notifications (e.g. password reset emails), protect the platform from fraud and comply with legal obligations.
legal.privacyP3: We do not sell your personal information. Information is only shared with service providers needed to operate the platform (hosting, email, payment processing) or when required by law.
legal.privacyP4: We apply reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect data. However, no method of transmission or storage is completely secure; you are responsible for keeping your login credentials confidential.
legal.privacyP5: You have the right to access, correct or request deletion of your personal information. To do so, please contact us using the details below.
legal.privacyP6Prefix: For any questions about this policy, please contact:
legal.termsMetaDesc: OmniCommerce terms of service: your rights and obligations when using the platform.
legal.termsIntro: By creating an account or using the OmniCommerce platform, you agree to the terms below. Please read them carefully before using the service.
legal.termsP1: You are responsible for the accuracy of your registration information and all activity under your account. Keep your login credentials secure and notify us if you discover unauthorized access.
legal.termsP2: You agree not to use the platform for unlawful purposes, not to upload content that violates the law or third-party rights, and not to interfere with the technical operation of the system.
legal.termsP3: You retain ownership of the products, images and content you upload. You are responsible for the goods and services you sell as well as compliance with the laws applicable to your business.
legal.termsP4: Some features may require payment. Terms regarding pricing, billing cycles and refunds (if any) will be clearly communicated at the time you subscribe to the relevant plan.
legal.termsP5: You may stop using the service at any time. We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms, after reasonable notice where possible.
legal.termsP6: We may update these terms from time to time. The new version takes effect once posted; your continued use of the service means you accept those changes.
legal.termsP7Prefix: For any questions about these terms, please contact:
